env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A source asset sharing its path with a compiler edit-map sidecar must
# survive eject. The sidecar write must not clobber it, so eject stops
# with a collision error naming the path instead of silently embedding
# map JSON under the asset's name.

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^ASSET: do not clobber'
logos build ./...
! logos eject -o out
stderr 'collides with a source file'
grep '^ASSET: do not clobber' out/main.go.edits

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/editmapcollision

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	_ "embed"
	"fmt"
)

//go:embed main.go.edits
var asset string

func main() {
	fmt.Println(asset)
}

-- m/main.go.edits --
ASSET: do not clobber.
